title: action.result body v1
description: Act -> brain: outcome of one intent.action. Every result is also appended to the audit log. Envelope conf = 1.0.

output.description: Human-readable outcome for the brain to phrase from ('Firefox launched', first 20 search hits, ...).

data.description: Optional structured payload (e.g. search hits) when the brain needs more than prose.

error.description: Present when ok=false. 'denied'/'confirm_timeout' are the confirmation-flow outcomes.

detail.description: Free-text error detail for logs and debugging.
